title: On perfectoid ideals
summary: In this paper, we study perfectoid ideals using the reduction modulo $p$ of perfectoid rings. We show that perfectoid ideals correspond to ideals in the reduction modulo $p$ on which Frobenius is surjective. We establish the existence of universal $p$-adic power series whose evaluations, together with their compatible $p$-power roots, generate perfectoidizations of ideals. In the special case of the perfectoidization of $\mathbb{Z}_p^{\mathrm{cycl}}\langle t^{1/p^{\infty}}\rangle/(t-1)$, we describe a linear algebra algorithm for computing finite approximations of such generators.
